title: Canonical route/reason/occurrence binding
change: CanonicalRoute.validate requires a deciding source and its exact canonical ask ID; ask is initial/update only; askr/askd are join/reissue with exact inbound occurrence. check_native_collision refuses another payload under retained legacy native keys, including initial-to-update revision collisions.
limitations: Future owner must atomically enforce native-key index and request dedup and authenticate source refresh lineage. Recovery askr epoch/request mapping is unsupported/HOLD in this partial slice.

title: Invalid receipt shape
change: Missing/wrong DTO and malformed ID field return closed invalid-receipt uncertainty. Only an immutable tuple containing exactly one matching lowercase message ID can confirm; no string splitting or implicit list conversion.
limitations: Actual production wire decoder remains deferred; it must explicitly validate/convert its closed JSON array before DTO construction.

title: Immutable bounded uncertainty diagnosis
change: Ordered distinct uncertainty kinds and append-only bounded raw prefix survive later empty/malformed/foreign receipts and final positive settlement. All correlation headers must match before IDs enter diagnosis. Maximum 4 kinds, 64 IDs, 16KiB raw; exact accepted receipt retained separately.
limitations: The prefix intentionally stops accepting diagnosis at the cap; it is not an unbounded archive or durable owner log.

title: Attempt target/source/trust binding
change: Required AttemptBinding freezes reply target, source token, registration epoch and full copy digest. Gate binding, receipt and every retry-history record must agree. Part>0 cannot reserve without concrete root; in-place payload/source/root changes refuse.
limitations: Synthetic structural source-token default is not authentication. Future owner supplies actual token/currentness/confirmed-root evidence and durability; no live caller or permissive missing gate/receipt binding is wired.

title: Distinct aggregate lifecycle status
change: All-cancelled reports cancelled; any exhausted part remains exhausted-held; superseded unresolved dispatch or duplicate receipts reports superseded-uncertain-held. Late confirmation remains superseded.
limitations: These are pure inspect summaries, not a production health renderer or permission to clear uncertainty.

title: Closed held/refused vocabulary
change: PolicyError.tag/code exposes the approved held/refused sets independent of diagnostic text. Source-changed, trust-denied, parent-incomplete, clock-unready, source-closed and exhausted have explicit codes. Not-yet-due is contention while preserving existing diagnostic and 0/5/30 timing.
limitations: No new source/trust availability adapter is supplied; full native typed outcomes remain the deferred owner boundary.

title: Dispatch-marked positive prewrite settlement
change: A dispatch-marked attempt may become proven_unissued only through exact identity/binding prewrite-refusal with explicit write_not_invoked=True. Bare proof, reserved-no-dispatch after mark, mislinks and any already uncertain attempt refuse. Exact positive fact is retained.
limitations: No transport error allowlist, absence inference or authenticated fact producer is invented. Actual owner must prove its open-before-write boundary. Healthy-absent and proof settlement of recovered uncertainty remain unavailable in this partial slice.

title: Frozen hash caching
change: FrozenCopy computes ordered-parts, full copy, text and native-key hashes once; transitions consume cached hashes. Test patches digest to fail on any later whole-copy rehash.
limitations: Admission/replacement computes a fresh frozen cache; no timing or production performance claim.

title: Runtime Literal single source
change: Reason/Profile/Phase/ProofKind/Uncertainty/SourceKind runtime validation uses get_args; receipt message-ID validation reuses _hex; proof phase consistency no longer repeats allowed-kind sets.
oracles: Existing and new closed-shape/proof/receipt oracles; full strict configured typing
limitations: ProofKind intentionally omits healthy-absent until actual durable proof contract exists; no source authority is inferred from the Literal.

title: Logical reminder lifetime identity
change: Immutable payload request key still binds revision as d4 specifies; separate reminder_key and pure ReminderBudget/consume_reminder survive revision/canonical ask-ID refresh and refuse another consumed logical reminder.
limitations: Future owner must authenticate logical lineage and atomically persist budget consumption with copy admission before reservation, retaining unknown consumption. No durable budget/timer/Store integration installed.
